title: MOASYS-Vault — output/plex/<library>/catalog.json
description: Every item in one Plex library as of the last pull: movies; shows and episodes; or artists, albums, and tracks. Generated by `npm run plex:pull`.

generated.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this library was pulled.

rating_key.description: Plex metadata id. The same id Plex's logs use to name items.

guid.description: Agent identifier, e.g. plex://movie/5d77…; local://… when unmatched.

external_ids.description: External ids such as imdb://tt0113277, tmdb://949, tvdb://….

grandparent_rating_key.description: Episode: the show's rating_key. Track: the artist's.

parent_rating_key.description: Episode: the season's rating_key. Track: the album's. Album: the artist's.

parent_title.description: Episode: season title. Track: album. Album: artist.

duplicate.description: Plex lists this item under its Duplicates filter.

files.description: One entry per file of every version. Empty for shows, artists, and albums.

plex_path.description: Path exactly as the server reports it.

drive.description: Root name from config.json this file maps to; null when unmapped.

library_path.description: Path relative to that root, forward slashes; null when unmapped.

deleted.description: Plex has flagged the file deleted — it's in the library trash.
